mission: Find assumptions about counts, ranges, lengths, paths, names, emptiness, and exact thresholds.
mindset: Every value has 0, 1, N-1, N, and N+1. Every collection can be empty. Every string can be blank, huge, Unicode, or awkward.
opening_moves: Find a likely limit N and probe N-1/N/N+1.

escalation_ladder.name: Canonical edges
actions: Try empty, zero, one, smallest valid, largest normal.

escalation_ladder.name: Threshold crossing
actions: Probe immediately below, at, and above limits.

escalation_ladder.name: Representation edge
actions: Use Unicode, combining marks, long names, and deep nesting.

escalation_ladder.name: Extreme sandbox edge
actions: Use large disposable inputs within configured safety caps.

signature_tactics.name: Empty universe
signature_tactics.purpose: Find assumptions that something always exists.
actions: Reduce state to smallest possible form.

signature_tactics.name: Representation edge
actions: Use long Unicode names and deep nesting.

combination_rules: Change one boundary dimension at a time first.
Then combine two proven weak edges and hand to Final Boss.
handoff_triggers: Finding seeds State Breaker or Wildcard.
